evaluation.failure_policy: report failures and coverage; primary complete-case score is invalid if a method silently omits any frozen test target
evaluation.primary_contrast: PINN minus matched multitask without CC residual, with identical independently verified training enthalpy labels
evaluation.primary_population: all eligible test cold episodes at 20000 Pa; no conditioning on enthalpy availability
evaluation.report_seed_rule: average paired differences across all five seeds; do not select a best seed
evaluation.temperature_levels: max minus min at most 0.1 K, sorted greedy grouping within one source series
evaluation.test_access: read final cold targets only after architecture, preprocessing, weights, adaptation and stopping rules are selected on training/validation; this is a retrospective pre-model holdout, not a blinded prospective dataset
evaluation.test_enthalpy_policy: all enthalpy labels of validation/test molecules withheld from fitting or adaptation

scope: curation freeze; candidate enthalpies quarantined pending primary methods and independent-lineage review
split_policy: keep connected components of connectivity, Morgan Tanimoto >=0.7, every eligible pressure DOI, candidate calorimetry reference, and conservative source aliases in one split; size-first deterministic greedy allocation; no model scores or seed search
